newsitem.title: USA: Group concerned over ImmuLogic dismissal.
newsitem.headline: Group concerned over ImmuLogic dismissal.

text.p: A group led by Amerindo Investment Advisors Inc said Thursday it raised concerns over the dismissal of ImmuLogic Pharmaceutical Corp's president and chief executive.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group, which holds a 17.34 percent stake in the company said it was concerned over the timing and circumstances behind the dismissal.
It said it also was concerned over the short-run operational and long-term strategic implications of the decision and the way it was implemented.
The group said it has informed the ImmuLlogic chairman and some shareholders about its concerns.

On December 4, ImmuLogic said Robert Gerety had resigned as president and CEO and had been replaced by Joseph Marr, who will add the two posts to his current job as executive vice president for research and development.
